assessor: Vigil on Claude Code (synthetic demo data)

findings.issue: Aadhaar numbers stored in plaintext in kyc_documents.aadhaar_number. Readiness gap: obligation applies from 13 May 2027.
findings.recommendation: Move Aadhaar numbers to an encrypted Aadhaar Data Vault and keep only a reference token in kyc_documents. Re-run /pii-scan db to confirm.

findings.issue: Signup bundles marketing consent into the Terms of Service checkbox.
findings.recommendation: Split into an unticked, separate marketing checkbox with its own itemised notice line.

findings.issue: Incident runbook has no step to intimate the Data Protection Board or an EU supervisory authority, and no 72-hour clock.
findings.recommendation: Add Board, supervisory authority, CERT-In (6h) and RBI (6h) notification steps with owners and timers; drill it quarterly with /dpdp-breach.

findings.issue: EU customer support tickets flow to a US-hosted helpdesk with no transfer mechanism recorded (data flow DF-04).
findings.recommendation: Confirm the vendor is DPF-certified or sign 2021 SCCs (Module 2), complete a transfer impact assessment, and record the mechanism in the data map.

findings.issue: No deletion job for closed accounts; credit data (DF-03) has no retention period.
findings.recommendation: Define retention per purpose and schedule a deletion job, keeping the minimum one-year logs required by Rule 8(3).

findings.issue: Consent is given with one tap, but withdrawal requires emailing support.
findings.recommendation: Add a one-tap withdrawal toggle in privacy settings that propagates to processors.

findings.issue: Analytics vendor (DF-05) processes device identifiers without a signed Data Processing Agreement.
findings.recommendation: Execute an Art. 28 DPA with the vendor; draft one with /gdpr-draft dpa.

findings.issue: SMS service logs full mobile numbers at INFO level.
findings.recommendation: Mask to the last four digits before logging.

findings.issue: Grievance page does not publish the response period.
findings.recommendation: Publish a response period of 30 days or less (Rule 14(3) ceiling is 90 days).
